cases.invariant: A governance contract over policy paths with full case coverage validates
cases.input: fixture governance contract: policy-only scope, Q1, GOV cases covering allow/deny/error and hook/ci
forbiddenEffects: a product contract accepting policy paths
Q0 accepted for a governance contract
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-ALLOW] A governance contract over policy paths with full case coverage validates

cases.invariant: A governance contract containing a product path is refused
cases.input: fixture governance contract whose scope includes src/app/page.tsx
forbiddenEffects: the product path validated as governance scope
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-DENY-PRODUCT-PATH] A governance contract containing a product path is refused

cases.invariant: A governance contract without allow, deny, error, hook and ci coverage is refused
cases.input: fixture governance contracts each missing one outcome or one layer
cases.response: one coverage error per missing outcome or layer
forbiddenEffects: an incomplete case set accepted
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-DENY-COVERAGE] A governance contract without allow, deny, error, hook and ci coverage is refused

cases.invariant: A governance contract is not releasable without an independent reviewed Opus approval and current hashes
cases.input: fixture governance contracts: planned stage, implemented stage, missing review, stale evidence/scope/report hash, implementation.role not Opus
forbiddenEffects: release of an unreviewed governance change
a stale review accepted
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-RELEASE-DENY] A governance contract is not releasable without an independent reviewed Opus approval and current hashes

cases.invariant: A reviewed governance contract with current hashes is releasable
cases.input: fixture reviewed governance contract with current review, evidence, scope and report hashes
forbiddenEffects: a valid reviewed contract refused
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-RELEASE-ALLOW] A reviewed governance contract with current hashes is releasable

cases.invariant: The governance report fails on a failing, missing or unproven case
cases.input: fixture contract with one failing mapped test, one unmapped case, one critical case without sensitivity
cases.response: nonzero exit, report status failed, named errors
forbiddenEffects: a failed or missing case reported as passed
cases.testName: [GOV-935-REPORT-ERROR] The governance report fails on a failing, missing or unproven case

cases.invariant: A reviewed contract stale only through rule files inside a reviewed governance contract is accepted with a valid rulesRebase
cases.input: fixture reviewed product contract, one changed .claude/rules file in the by-contract scope, valid rulesRebase and evidence
forbiddenEffects: a rule-only change forcing an unaudited rewrite of review.scopeSha256
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-REBASE-ALLOW] A reviewed contract stale only through rule files inside a reviewed governance contract is accepted with a valid rulesRebase

cases.invariant: A rulesRebase never hides a non-rule change or an unapproved rule change
cases.input: fixture rebases with a changed scope or test file, a non-governance or unreviewed by-contract, a rule file outside the by scope, a stale evidence hash
cases.response: Independent review scope is stale or a named rebase error for each
forbiddenEffects: a product code change accepted under an old review
cases.testName: [GOV-935-VAL-REBASE-DENY] A rulesRebase never hides a non-rule change or an unapproved rule change

cases.invariant: The session that wrote a governance scope file cannot approve it
cases.input: transcript with a successful Write to a scope file, governance receipt, APPROVED
forbiddenEffects: a self-approval accepted
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-SELF-APPROVE-DENY] The session that wrote a governance scope file cannot approve it

cases.invariant: An independent session with a reviewed contract and passing report may approve
cases.input: transcript without scope writes, governance receipt, reviewed contract, passing report, APPROVED
forbiddenEffects: an independent approval refused
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-INDEPENDENT-ALLOW] An independent session with a reviewed contract and passing report may approve

cases.invariant: A push command written inline, in a table cell or after a label is a push handoff
cases.input: replies with the push command in inline code, a table cell and labelled prose
cases.response: each reply is checked as a push handoff and refused without the required conditions
forbiddenEffects: an unchecked push handoff
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-PUSH-INLINE-DENY] A push command written inline, in a table cell or after a label is a push handoff

cases.invariant: A push handoff to main, HEAD, a refspec or a bare push is refused
cases.input: APPROVED replies whose push targets main, HEAD, a refspec, or has no branch
forbiddenEffects: a direct push to main handed off
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-PUSH-MAIN-DENY] A push handoff to main, HEAD, a refspec or a bare push is refused

cases.invariant: An approved single task-branch push with an active ruleset is allowed
cases.input: APPROVED reply with one task-branch push, injected active ruleset
forbiddenEffects: a valid task-branch push refused
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-PUSH-BRANCH-ALLOW] An approved single task-branch push with an active ruleset is allowed

cases.invariant: A push handoff fails closed when the main ruleset is missing, inactive or unreadable
cases.input: injected missing, inactive and throwing ruleset sources
forbiddenEffects: a push handed off without server-side protection
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-RULESET-ERROR] A push handoff fails closed when the main ruleset is missing, inactive or unreadable

cases.invariant: A merge handoff with an admin or auto flag, or in the same reply as a push, is refused
cases.input: replies with the PR merge command plus the admin flag, plus the auto flag, and together with a push
forbiddenEffects: a merge that bypasses required checks
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-MERGE-ADMIN-DENY] A merge handoff with an admin or auto flag, or in the same reply as a push, is refused

cases.invariant: A read-only repository subcommand with an output-file write is refused
cases.input: read-only subcommands carrying an output-file option
forbiddenEffects: a repository file written through a read-only command
cases.testName: [GOV-935-HOOK-GIT-WRITE-DENY] A read-only repository subcommand with an output-file write is refused

cases.invariant: A changed executable policy file outside every governance contract scope fails the diff check
cases.input: diff with a changed scripts/workflow-gates .mjs file and no governance contract
cases.response: outside every changed governance contract scope
forbiddenEffects: an executable policy change merged without a contract
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-DIFF-DENY] A changed executable policy file outside every governance contract scope fails the diff check

cases.invariant: A changed executable policy file inside a reviewed governance contract passes the release diff check
cases.input: diff with the policy file and its reviewed governance contract
forbiddenEffects: a covered governance change refused
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-DIFF-ALLOW] A changed executable policy file inside a reviewed governance contract passes the release diff check

cases.invariant: A rulesRebase whose by-contract is not in the same diff is refused
cases.input: diff with a rebased contract but without its governance by-contract
forbiddenEffects: a rebase accepted without its approving governance change
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-REBASE-DENY] A rulesRebase whose by-contract is not in the same diff is refused

cases.invariant: A green pull_request run with the release-only job skipped counts as green
cases.input: injected PR run, all required jobs success, Release Security Required skipped
forbiddenEffects: a green PR reported red
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-PR-STATUS-ALLOW] A green pull_request run with the release-only job skipped counts as green

cases.invariant: A failed, pending or mismatched PR run is not green
cases.input: injected PR runs with a failed job, a pending job and a different head SHA
forbiddenEffects: a merge on a red or stale PR run
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-PR-STATUS-DENY] A failed, pending or mismatched PR run is not green

cases.invariant: The ruleset manifest without every PR-only rule and both required checks is refused
cases.input: manifests missing pull_request, required checks, strict mode or one context
forbiddenEffects: an unprotected main accepted as configured
cases.testName: [GOV-935-CI-RULESET-DENY] The ruleset manifest without every PR-only rule and both required checks is refused
